title: Weights at least one with total at most one force a single plane through the origin
statement: Let P, N ∈ ℕ, m and ν measures on ℝ^P, V a linear subspace of ℝ^P, w_1, …, w_N ∈ ℝ^P and α_1, …, α_N ∈ ℝ (indices in Fin N). Assume α_i ≥ 1 for every i, Σ_iα_i ≤ 1, w_{i₀} = 0 for some i₀, and ν = Σ_i ofReal(α_i)·(m⌞{y : y − w_i ∈ V}). Then ν = m⌞V.
lean_statement: ∀ (P N : ℕ) (m ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (w : Fin N → Euclid P) (α : Fin N → ℝ), (∀ i, 1 ≤ α i) → ∑ i, α i ≤ 1 → (∃ i, w i = 0) → ν = ∑ i, ENNReal.ofReal (α i) • m.restrict {y : Euclid P | y - w i ∈ V} → ν = m.restrict (V : Set (Euclid P))
